_legenda: English descriptions for desktop/funcoes.json (same keys). c = confirmed (tested on the device or seen in UI/app code); i = INFERRED (from name/context only)
misns/wifi_share_info: Guest network: on/off, name, password and security.
misns/wifi_share_switch: Local guest network switch used by the cloud; parameters unknown (code 1523). Use set_wifi_without_restart.
misystem/active: Triggers the speed-history refresh (used after the speed test).
misystem/arn_ignore: Ignores/releases a device flagged by the anti-intrusion feature.
misystem/arn_security: Security center: privacy protection, malicious-site firewall and virus-file firewall.
misystem/arn_security_switch: Turns the security center protections on/off.
misystem/arn_status: Anti-intrusion (防蹭网): on/off, level and count of blocked attempts.
misystem/arn_switch: Turns anti-intrusion on/off and sets the level (parameters unconfirmed).
misystem/c_backup: Creates a configuration backup file (keys = parts to include).
misystem/c_upload: Uploads the backup file to restore.
misystem/channel_scan_result: Channel optimization result (current/suggested channel and score).
misystem/channel_scan_start: Starts the Wi-Fi optimization channel scan.
misystem/check_status: Quick router check used by the app.
misystem/devicelist: Known devices: name, MAC, IP, online, connection type (0 wired, 1 2.4 GHz, 2 5 GHz, 3 guest), speeds and permissions.
misystem/extendwifi_scanlist: Lists nearby networks for wireless repeater mode.
misystem/get_dev_bsd: Preferred band of a device on unified Wi-Fi (needs parameters).
misystem/get_usb_u3: USB 3.0 mode status (no effect on the AX1800, which has no USB).
misystem/http_status: Status of the router's HTTP interception (e.g. warning pages).
misystem/iperf: iperf server to measure local network speed.
misystem/led: LED status; with on=0/1 turns the device lights off/on.
misystem/messages: Router notices (update available, 5 GHz failure, IP conflict).
misystem/minet_get_state: MiNet status (quick setup of Xiaomi devices); returns an error on this device.
misystem/netacctl_set: Sets a device's internet access control.
misystem/newstatus: 2.4/5 GHz summary (name and connected clients). Warning: returns the 2.4 GHz password in the 'pssswd' field.
misystem/parctl_add: Parental control: creates a schedule rule.
misystem/parctl_info: Parental control: rules per device (needs parameters).
misystem/qos_dev_info: QoS limit of a specific device (needs parameters).
misystem/qos_guest: Guest network speed limit (percent, percent_up of the bandwidth).
misystem/qos_info: QoS settings: on/off, mode, bandwidth, guest network limit and per-device limits.
misystem/qos_info_new: Newer QoS summary used by the app (bandwidth, limits per MAC).
misystem/qos_limits: Writes per-device speed limits (data as JSON).
misystem/qos_set_dev_info: Writes a device's QoS limit (used by the app).
misystem/r_ip_conflict: Resolves an IP conflict with the upstream router by changing the LAN range.
misystem/repair_status: Status of the diagnosis' automatic network repair.
misystem/router_common_status: Summary for the app: devices, WAN speed and USB.
misystem/set_band: Sets the contracted bandwidth (upload/download in Mbps) used by QoS.
misystem/set_channel: Applies the channel suggested by the optimization.
misystem/set_dev_bsd: Pins a device's band on unified Wi-Fi.
misystem/set_sys_time: Sets the time zone (timezone, index) or the time (time 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss').
misystem/smartvpn_mac: Devices routed through the smart VPN.
misystem/smartvpn_url: Domains routed through the smart VPN.
misystem/speed_test_result: Result of the app's speed test.
misystem/start_portscan: Starts a scan of exposed ports.
misystem/status: Overall status: uptime, CPU, memory, device count, WAN traffic (current, peak, total) and hardware.
misystem/sys_log: Generates a system-log package and returns the download path.
misystem/sys_time: Router time, time zone (timezone + option index) and Mesh role (whc_cap main / whc_re node).
misystem/topo_graph: Mesh network topology: main router and nodes (name, IP, location, model).
misystem/usb_u3: Turns USB 3.0 on/off (enable) — no effect on the AX1800.
misystem/vas_info: Value-added services (Xiaomi ads/plug-ins); empty on this device.
misystem/web_access_info: Admin access control: on/off and list of allowed MACs.
misystem/web_access_opt: Turns access control on/off and adds/removes allowed MACs.
xqdatacenter/request: Generic numbered-command channel ('api' in the payload) used by the UI and the cloud.
xqnetwork/add_mesh_node: Adds a discovered Mesh node (mac, locate).
xqnetwork/check_wan_type: Detects the recommended internet connection type.
xqnetwork/ddns: DDNS status: on, flag, list[] of configured providers.
xqnetwork/ddns_switch: Turns DDNS on/off (on=1/0). Tested 2026-11-08 (on=0 → xqnetwork/ddns on=0).
xqnetwork/disable_ap: Leaves wireless repeater mode (back to router).
xqnetwork/dmz: DMZ: status and target IP. Status meaning (1 = on, 2 = off) inferred — only 2 confirmed, with the DMZ off.
xqnetwork/edit_device: Adds (option=0) or removes (option=1) a MAC from the filter list.
xqnetwork/get_addnode_status: Progress of adding a Mesh node.
xqnetwork/get_miotrelay_switch: Quick connect (畅快连) status for Mi Home devices.
xqnetwork/get_son_backhaul_mode: 'Priority for many devices' (多终端接入优先) status.
xqnetwork/lan_dhcp: DHCP server settings (range, lease, DNS, gateway).
xqnetwork/mac_bind: Creates IP reservations (data = JSON [{ip, mac, name}]).
xqnetwork/mac_clone: Clones a MAC address on the WAN.
xqnetwork/macbind_info: IP reservations (static DHCP) and device list.
xqnetwork/manually_add: Manually adds a device (name + MAC) to the filter list.
xqnetwork/portforward: Port forwards: name, protocol (1 TCP, 2 UDP, 3 both), external port and target IP:port.
xqnetwork/pppoe_catch: Captures the PPPoE user/password from an old router connected to the WAN.
xqnetwork/scan_mesh_node: Looks for Mesh nodes available to add.
xqnetwork/set_all_wifi: Changes both bands at once (unified Wi-Fi; restarts Wi-Fi ~30 s). The guest fields on3/ssid3/pwd3 are accepted but ignored on the RM1800.
xqnetwork/set_lan_dhcp: Changes or turns off the DHCP server.
xqnetwork/set_peer_wifi_auto_ap_mode: Automatic access-point setup between Mesh nodes.
xqnetwork/set_son_backhaul_mode: Turns priority for many devices on/off (mode).
xqnetwork/set_wan: Changes the internet connection (PPPoE, DHCP or static IP).
xqnetwork/set_wan6: IPv6 mode (POST): wanType=native (passes the ISP prefix through, which changes on every reconnection), nat (NAT6: home network with fixed prefix fd00:6868:6868::/64) or static; autosetipv6=0/1 (automatic/manual DNS), dns1, dns2.
xqnetwork/set_wifi: Changes a Wi-Fi network (wifiIndex 1=2.4 GHz, 2=5 GHz, 3=guest): name, password, security, channel, width, hidden, power; and weak-signal roaming.
xqnetwork/set_wifi_ax: Wi-Fi 6 on (ax=1) or Wi-Fi 5 compatibility mode (ax=0).
xqnetwork/set_wifi_macfilter: Turns the MAC filter on/off and sets its mode (model, enable).
xqnetwork/set_wifi_without_restart: Changes only the given fields without restarting Wi-Fi. wifiIndex=3 + on=1/0 turns the guest network on/off; wifiIndex=1/2 + hidden=1/0 hides/shows the SSID (not mirrored to the Mesh node).
xqnetwork/wan_info: Internet: type (PPPoE/DHCP/static), IP, gateway, DNS, MTU, connected time, IPv6 and MAC in use.
xqnetwork/wifi_detail_all: Full Wi-Fi settings per band (name, password, security, channel, width, power, hidden, Wi-Fi 6, MU-MIMO, roaming) and unified Wi-Fi.
xqnetwork/wifi_list: Nearby Wi-Fi networks (for wireless repeater mode).
xqnetwork/wifi_macfilter_info: Wi-Fi MAC filter: on/off, mode (blocklist/allowlist) and list.
xqnetwork/wifiap_signal: Signal quality to the upstream router (node/repeater).
xqsmarthome/request_smartcontroller: Scenes/schedules engine (the app's scheduled reboot). Parameter format not discovered.
xqsystem/check_rom_update: Checks Xiaomi's servers for a firmware update.
xqsystem/country_code: Current Wi-Fi region and options (China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Korea, Europe).
xqsystem/device_list_zigbee: Zigbee devices of routers with a built-in gateway (not applicable to the AX1800).
xqsystem/flash_permission: Checks whether firmware flashing is allowed.
xqsystem/get_languages: Original UI languages (Simplified Chinese, Traditional HK/TW).
xqsystem/init_info: Public router information (model, version, region); answers without login.
xqsystem/login: Admin login (nonce + sha1); returns the session token.
xqsystem/oneclick_get_remote_token: Token for remote cloud access (app binding).
xqsystem/router_bind_ok: Confirms binding the router to the Xiaomi account (used by the app via the cloud).
xqsystem/set_country_code: Changes the Wi-Fi region (channels and power).
xqsystem/set_mac_filter: Blocks (wan=0) or allows (wan=1) a device's internet access.
xqsystem/set_name_password: Changes the admin password (proprietary AES encryption).
xqsystem/system_info: Model, version, firmware channel, uptime and name.
xqsystem/upgrade_status: Progress of an ongoing firmware update.
xqsystem/upload_log: Uploads the system logs to Xiaomi.
xqsystem/upload_rom: Uploads a firmware file for a manual update.
xqsystem/upnp: UPnP: on (status 1) and list of port mappings created automatically by devices.
xqsystem/usbmode: Prepares USB for an update (no effect on the AX1800).
xqsystem/usbservice: Turns USB services on/off during an update.
xqsystem/vpn: VPN client configuration (PPTP/L2TP): server, user, protocol.
